longTitle: What Net Worth Puts You in the Top 10% at 65–74? (New Fed Data)
sources: Sources: Federal Reserve Board, 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances, summary extract public data (our calculation with survey weights; 2025 dollars).
music_credits: Music by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.

clips.title: The net worth that puts you in the top 10% at 65–74 (Fed 2025) #Shorts
clips.desc: Households 65–74, Federal Reserve 2025 SCF (our calculation): bottom 25% under $118k, median $431k, top 25% from $1.3M, top 10% from $3.6M.

clips.title: 1 in 3 households aged 65–74 are millionaires #Shorts
clips.desc: Share with net worth of at least $500k: 45%, $1M: 31%, $2M: 19%, $5M: 8% (Federal Reserve 2025 SCF, our calculation).
